_meta.label: TEMPLATE DATA - NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED
_meta.note: Placeholder sports opportunity records for development, testing, and demo use. Organizations, deadlines, and source URLs are TEMPLATE values pending verification with real Pakistani data. Date convention: deadline/last_verified values starting with '+' or '-' are day offsets from the seed date, 'today' = the seed date; anything else is an ISO date. Records marked is_active=false are deliberate negative examples that must never surface in student results.
_meta.created_for: Final implementation - controlled starter dataset (spec section 8)
